changeSet.comment: RSDEV-1706: Inventory fields gain a field key, copied with the field, and an optional display rule that references another field of the same template by that key

changeSet.author: tchoi-rs
changeSet.comment: RSDEV-1706: Give every existing sample and instrument template field a key, so any field an author can pick in a display rule has one. Fields of samples and instruments are copies and keep a null key until they are updated to the latest template version.
changeSet.sql: update InventoryEntityField f join Sample s on s.id = f.sample_id set f.fieldKey = UUID() where f.fieldKey is null and s.DTYPE = 'SampleTemplate'; update InventoryEntityField f join InstrumentEntity i on i.id = f.instrumentEntity_id set f.fieldKey = UUID() where f.fieldKey is null and i.DTYPE = 'InstrumentTemplate';
